description: Complete the ALS (Alternating Least Squares) collaborative filtering code to recommend items to users based on implicit feedback.
expectedOutput:
When completed correctly, this code will:
1. Configure ALS with user, item, and rating columns
2. Set hyperparameters (rank, maxIter, regParam)
3. Handle cold start users/items with a drop strategy
4. Train the ALS model on the data
5. Generate top-N recommendations for all users
codeTemplate:
# Configure ALS model for collaborative filtering
als = ALS(
    # Specify column names
    userCol=__BLANK_0__,
    itemCol=__BLANK_1__,
    ratingCol=__BLANK_2__,
    
    # Hyperparameters
    rank=__BLANK_3__,              # Number of latent features
    maxIter=__BLANK_4__,           # Maximum training iterations
    regParam=__BLANK_5__,          # Regularization parameter
    
    # Handle cold start problem
    coldStartStrategy=__BLANK_6__
)

# Train the model
model = als.fit(train_df)

# Generate top 10 recommendations for all users
user_recs = model.__BLANK_7__(10)
hints: The column names should match the schema: user_id, product_id, rating
rank=10 is a good starting point (not too small, not too large)
coldStartStrategy='drop' removes users/items with no ratings
Use recommendForAllUsers() to generate top-N recommendations
learnings: fit() trains the model on data
